theme_strategy: Premium Corporate Fintech & Tax ERP. Professional, trustworthy, dynamic. Light theme dominant with strong Royal Blue anchor and vibrant Yellow accent.

glassmorphism.light_mode: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] backdrop-saturate-150
glassmorphism.dark_mode: bg-[#0A2540]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl backdrop-saturate-150

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFB800] text-[#0A2540] font-bold rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#E5A600] transition-colors shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0A2540] text-white font-semibold rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#1E3A8A] transition-colors shadow-md border border-[#1E3A8A]

surface_1_unified_login_page.left_panel_branding: w-full lg:w-1/2 bg-[#0A2540] relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between p-12 text-white. Use Mumbai skyline image as absolute background with bg-[#0A2540]/80 mix-blend-multiply overlay. Content: Logo top left, bold value prop in center, live stats/services grid at bottom.
surface_1_unified_login_page.right_panel_auth: w-full lg:w-1/2 bg-[#F8FAFC] flex items-center justify-center p-8. Use Glassmorphism card for the login container.
surface_1_unified_login_page.role_switcher: Framer-motion powered animated tabs (Super Admin / Employee / Customer / Agent) with active state in Royal Blue and yellow indicator. Forms switch seamlessly (Email/Password vs Mobile/OTP).

surface_2_customer_marketing_homepage.hero_section: Generous spacing (py-32). Left text (h1 in Chivo, primary CTA, secondary CTA), Right dynamic image or dashboard mockup. Background subtle #F8FAFC.
surface_2_customer_marketing_homepage.trust_strip: Logos of clients/partners in grayscale with low opacity, scrolling horizontally using react-fast-marquee.
surface_2_customer_marketing_homepage.services_grid: Bento-style grid. Cards use white background, 1px border border-slate-200, hover:shadow-xl transition-all.
surface_2_customer_marketing_homepage.statistics: Dark section (bg-[#0A2540]). Big numbers in #FFB800, text in white.
surface_2_customer_marketing_homepage.testimonials: Masonry or carousel layout. Cards with glassmorphism over a subtle abstract background.
surface_2_customer_marketing_homepage.team_and_gallery: High-quality corporate imagery, sharp corners or very subtle rounding (rounded-md) to maintain enterprise seriousness.
surface_2_customer_marketing_homepage.footer: Deep blue bg-[#051324] with golden accents for links.

surface_3_ai_tax_copilot.placement: Floating panel bottom-right, distinct from WhatsApp button.
surface_3_ai_tax_copilot.container: w-[380px] h-[600px] shadow-2xl rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col bg-white border border-slate-200.
surface_3_ai_tax_copilot.header: bg-[#0A2540] text-white p-4 flex items-center gap-3. AI Avatar icon, status indicator.
surface_3_ai_tax_copilot.chat_body: bg-slate-50 p-4 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto. User bubbles: bg-[#0A2540] text-white. AI bubbles: bg-white text-slate-800 border border-slate-200.
surface_3_ai_tax_copilot.input_area: p-4 bg-white border-t border-slate-100. Modern rounded input, send button in #FFB800.

framer_motion.page_transitions: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}

motion.micro_interactions: Smooth tab switching for Login role selector using layoutId from framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #0F172A text on #F8FAFC background. Check yellow #FFB800 buttons use dark text #0A2540 for contrast (WCAG AA).
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., login-submit-button, hero-cta-btn).

image_urls.description: Mumbai skyline night view. Use with deep blue overlay for login left panel.
Corporate finance meeting. Good for marketing home hero or consulting service card.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Implement the split-screen login page strictly using the provided layout and color tokens. Add the role switcher using framer-motion.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For the Marketing Home, construct the required sections (Hero, Services, Stats, Testimonials, Team, Projects, Contact, Footer) in a premium enterprise style. Avoid generic center-aligned bootstrap-style layouts.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement a Chat interface component for the AI Tax Copilot, styled as a premium widget.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Make sure all headings use Chivo font and body uses IBM Plex Sans.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not break existing React/CRA/Tailwind setup. Only add/update files inside /frontend/src.

universal_guidelines: Do not use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions. DO NOT center align the app container. Create depth with z-index hierarchy. Ensure generous spacing. Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
